newsitem.title: CANADA: Pembina Resources launches takeover of Serenpet.
newsitem.headline: Pembina Resources launches takeover of Serenpet.

text.p: Pembina Resources Ltd announced on Friday that it will make a $110-million offer for all of the approximately 23 million common shares of Serenpet Inc.
The offer of $4.80 per share includes a 14 percent premium above the weighted average trading price of Serenpet shares during the last 20 trading days, the companies said.
Serenpet's board of directors unanimously recommended that the company's shareholders accept the offer.
The agreement between the two companies allows Pembina to match any subsequent offer and requires Serenpet to close its data room and cease soliciting offers, the companies said.
Pembina's offer is subject to a condition that at least two-thirds of Serenpet's shares be deposited under the offer, the companies said.
